main_text.p: Essena etiam in præfectura suburbanâ. Præposiu[?]re:Præterea Præpositurae, sacerdotii genus opimum & honoratum, à Monasterienfi Præfule [illegible, ~5 letters] ac quietis causâ introductum in hæc loca, quatuor, Farmsuma-na, Loppershemia, Vsquerdia, Leensia: quinta in Hommerziis jamdudum extri-ta. Canonici,Collegium quoque canonicorum, aut ut tum vulgò loquendi mos habebat, ecclesia collegiata apud Bedumanos cum fano ibidem illustri, supra fanorum rusticorum modum; cui primus sacerdos non temerè alius, quàm aut genere aut doctrinæ titulo conspicuus solet dari, magno honore atque autoritate in populo. Denique pastura Baffloa in Hunef-Pasto- ræ.[?]goniis, itemque Middelsthemia, vicario munere pro Monasteriensi olim decoratæ. Nec ad hæc, quod miretis, Regum aut Principum liberalitas quicquam contulit, sed rusticæ plebis studia, paucorumque nobilium ista sanè, quàm pro re ac agri modo majora congessêre[?].

page.notes: Marginal note beside the first lines: "Præposiu[?]re:" is printed across two lines, the first ending in a doubtful letter. The bold display note "Pa-westdyc" with "(Videinf.)" below it is hard to read; the first word and the place name are uncertain and may be misprinted. The Greek-looking word after "Præfule" is not legible enough to transcribe. The note "Canonici," stands beside the line with "extri-ta.". The first paragraph's opening word and the note "ræ." are read with doubt; the verb "congessêre" is partly illegible. The bracket after "addat" is a printed mark, copied as it stands.
